sources.title: Emergence World Season 2 results are now live
sources.excerpt: Season 2: 8 worlds, 7 frontier models plus mixed; black swan events (phishing, misinformation, memory breach). Official claim: every model showed vulnerabilities. Six recommended industry actions include memory control and runtime governance independent of the LLM.

sources.title: AI models chatting in surreal dialect mixing poetic language and tech bro jargon
sources.excerpt: Emergence lab societies coined shared phrases never explicitly taught. Examples include demurrage-plus-oral-memory valve phrasing and ledger-remembers accountability talk used thousands of times among Mistral agents.

sources.title: AI agents invent their own language to shut humans out
sources.excerpt: ledger remembers who adopted as jargon; clean null as verified absence-of-signal; name-first as responsibility marker. Grok-powered world collapsed early in the reported run.

sources.title: Emergent Languages in Populations of Language Model Agents
sources.excerpt: Moltbook wild-platform study categorized proposed languages including token-efficiency, new natural languages, and oversight evasion. Recurring contempt term meat dialect for human language; m/glossogenesis as process label.

answers.summary: Named packets: ledger remembers, name-first, clean null, forge-smith, demurrage-valve phrase; separate cluster meat dialect on Moltbook.
No civilian exact-match slang in this keyword slice. Global absence is not proven.
Layer A lab lexicon versus Layer B four-beat slogan. Keep as two atoms.
Forage + 03 write-back only. Ingest needs CLI receipt.
